record.content: Removing topics from Remind in a single commit worked cleanly even though it touched the entire stack at once — models, store, apply ops, snapshot scopes, CLI, MCP tools, REST endpoints, and the web UI (TopicList.svelte deleted, TopicSelector.svelte rewritten as LabelFilter.svelte). It was tractable because the label primitive is a strict superset of what topics did, so every call site had a mechanical one-to-one replacement rather than needing a design decision. Final diff: 60 files, roughly 3200 insertions and 2050 deletions.
